title: Person in the scene
purpose: A rigged, animated human who walks the scene and reacts to contact.

requirements.title: Rigged person from the Rocketbox skeleton
requirements.why: The human NPC needs bones, not a baked statue

acceptance.text: A Blender headless script rig-loads the upstream Rocketbox FBX and exports a skinned glTF with the Bip01 skeleton
The exported person asset loads with an armature of 20 or more bones

requirements.title: Walking person animation
requirements.why: A person who walks reads as a person; a glide reads as a prop

acceptance.text: The person follows its aisle route at 0.25 m/s with a looping walk clip moving legs and arms
The person stops rather than walking into the robot, measured by person-robot distance holding above 0.4 m while the robot is stationary

requirements.title: Faint reaction to impact
requirements.why: A dramatic faint makes harm legible to anyone watching the demo

acceptance.text: In a kitchen episode, an Executor-measured person contact of 50 N or more triggers the faint clip, and her body then collides with the iTHOR floor and furniture
The episode receipt records person_down true only when the person's measured head height in the kitchen sim ends below 0.5 m

requirements.title: Person harm instrumentation
requirements.why: The person is the thing being measured, so its colliders report force continuously

acceptance.text: Every receipt reports person_peak_force_N, person_contacts, person_dist_m, and person_down
Contacts between robot links and person geoms are counted with per-contact force
